about: Pinned inputs of the ProsperoAI build. `make deps` (tools/deps.py) fetches every missing item and leaves existing checkouts and files untouched. Paths are relative to this repository; ../ means next to it.

items.name: payload-sdk
items.about: PS5 Payload SDK v0.42 (toolchain, libSceNet/libSceAgc import stubs, prospero-clang)

items.name: llama-cpp
items.about: Upstream llama.cpp master pinned for the shared Vulkan runtime

items.name: vulkan-headers
items.about: Khronos Vulkan-Headers (newer than the host's packaged 1.3.239; ggml-vulkan needs VK_EXT_layer_settings)

items.name: ps5-vulkan-tools
items.about: Mihawk's PS5_Vulkan: the RADV build and link recipes

items.name: ps5-payload-sdk-fork
items.about: Mihawk's PS5 Payload SDK fork used to build RADV

items.name: stable-diffusion-vulkan
items.about: Experimental SD backend built against the same ggml ABI as Vulkan text

items.name: llama-prism
items.about: Isolated Bonsai 2 PTQ1_0/PQ2_0 and Hadamard runtime, Prism release prism-b10772-e8fd209; does not replace shared media llama

items.name: ggml-upstream
items.about: Upstream GGML shared by llama.cpp, Stable Diffusion, Kokoro and audio.cpp

items.name: kokoro-cpp
items.about: kokoro.cpp: ggml/Vulkan runtime for Kokoro-82M speech; replaces the prebuilt OpenCL archive. Only Highway is checked out as a submodule, because KOKORO_GGML_DIR points at the pinned ggml this build already uses.

items.name: audio-cpp
items.about: Pinned audio.cpp C API for Stable Audio 3, ACE-Step and Chatterbox, built by the upstream GGML audio adapter

items.name: onnxruntime
items.about: ONNX Runtime v1.22.1 for the Chatterbox ONNX CPU adapter; PS5 FreeBSD changes are in tools/patches/onnxruntime-1.22.1-ps5.patch

items.name: espeak-ng-headers
items.about: espeak-ng 1.51 source, used only for its public headers. kokoro.cpp links espeak-ng directly and the PS5 build has no system copy; the symbols come from vendor/lib/libespeak-ng.a.
